### Summary

Implemented plan 2026-05-09-004 F001 as an opt-in Firebase realtime overlay strictly inside `dashboard/**`: the new `dashboard/config-firebase.js` module exposes a dependency-injected `attachFirestoreRealtime` core plus a `initFirebaseRealtime` browser bootstrap that lazy-loads the Firebase Web SDK from gstatic and subscribes to the seven F001 streams under single-tenant `projects/{project_id}/<stream>` (multi-tenant `tenants/{tenantId}/...` is rejected by `buildStreamPath`). A `JARVIS_A6EE1_CONFIG_TEMPLATE` block targets `<firebase-project-id>` with `REPLACE_*` placeholders for credential fields — real values land when F003+ reactivates per D007, and `loadFirebaseConfig` treats placeholders as "not configured" so first paint and offline still come from the static loader in `core.js`. Operator opt-in is the new `index-firebase.htm
